title: Cindy Crawford's son Presley Gerber dies at 27
description: Presley Gerber, the son of Cindy Crawford and Rande Gerber, has died at 27 years old, according to a report from the Los Angeles Medical Examiner.

title: One Issue That Could Upend Fragile U.S.-China Ties: Taiwan Arms
description: As Beijing presses President Trump to freeze a proposed $14 billion weapons sale to the island, Taiwan is trying to show that its security is in U.S. interests.

title: ‘Way Too Hot’: Britain’s Hospitals Were Not Built for 96-Degree Summers
description: Patients and workers in one of the country’s largest hospitals sweltered in a heat wave last month. Experts say the whole country must urgently adapt.

title: UK should 'team up' with Canada in new Europe alliance, Canadian minister tells BBC
description: It comes after European Commission President proposed "opening the door" for Canada to become an associate member of the EU.

title: Young people aren't snowflakes - mental distress is rising, says head of official review
description: Speaking exclusively to the BBC, Prof Fonagy says being young is much harder now than it was.
